A particular feature is being examined across $3$ groups of individuals to determine if the mean varies by group. The table below shows the values of this feature for three samples, each consisting of $4$ individuals from each group.

| Group 1 | Group 2 | Group 3 |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| $10$ | $9.5$ | $7$ |
| $9$ | $10.5$ | $10$ |
| $11$ | $7$ | $11.5$ |
| $12$ | $8$ | $8.5$ |

What is the sum of squares within groups (SSW) for these samples?

> A scientific calculator is required to answer this question.
